verdict.rationale: Granola documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp.granola.ai) supporting search, transcripts, and meeting queries, and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and enforces OAuth via the standard MCP protected-resource flow (401 + WWW-Authenticate pointing to oauth-protected-resource metadata), matching the story's OAuth/no-glue-code requirement. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on confirmation of a successful end-to-end OAuth connection and action-item retrieval.
